posts.title: YouTubeToLingQ - turning YouTube videos into A2 German reading practice
posts.description: I've been stepping up with my learning German and currently one of my favourite tools is LingQ . You can read upload text in your target language, and get an instant translation of specific words in the reader, and it keeps track of your vocabulary over time. posts.title: Why you do not need blockchain for archiving historical data
posts.description: TLDR: You can take the useful part of blockchains - hash chains - and reject the resource wasting over complexity. posts.title: Combining Ancestry and 23andMe Data with AWK
